question: Which of the following statements regarding clopidogrel is correct ?:

options.opa: It is covalently bound to a serine residue of the cyclooxygenase.
options.opb: It is a prodrug activated by a metabolic reduction process.
options.opc: Its target is the thromboxane receptor, to which it binds reversibly.
options.opd: One of its metabolites binds irreversibly to a cysteine ​​residue of its receptor.
